capabilities: Search places via Google Places API from the command palette
Create notes with frontmatter populated from place details
Apply custom templates to generated notes
Configure filename patterns and target folders
Report API errors such as invalid keys and rate limits
extras: MVP has no caching and no rate limiting; roadmap lists updating existing notes, bulk imports, offline mode and custom field mappings. Extra docs live in a CONTEXT/ folder. Google notes the $200 monthly free credit usually covers personal use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up place details, so users must manually copy and format information from Google Maps into notes.

relations.evidence: Search for places using Google Places API

summary: Command-palette plugin that searches Google Places and creates notes with structured place metadata in frontmatter.
